svg.title: UX-10 mockup 1 · New game, engine off
svg.desc: Annotated main-window mockup. Numbered amber callouts match the notes on the right.

svg.text: Proposal mockup (dark theme, English, 1280×800). Board, header icons and panel colors follow the real app baseline. Numbers are illustrative.

svg.text: PROPOSAL

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: First action: Analyze

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Stays the one blue primary button. It starts the

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: engine if needed, then analyzes. Adds the F5 key

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: hint and the tooltip 'Starts the engine, then

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: analyzes this position'.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: PROPOSAL

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Start engine is a different, secondary action

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Engine strip shows a text chip 'Off' (dashed ring)

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: and a labelled 'Start engine' button. It only

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: launches the engine. A search starts from Analyze,

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: or from Analyze mode or Engine plays if either is

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: armed. Today it is an unlabelled play icon next to

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: the red OFF. This reverses part of UI-21, which

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: turned the engine-status buttons into icons.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: PROPOSAL

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop analysis, disabled

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Header Stop is relabelled 'Stop analysis' and dims.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: It cancels the search and disarms Engine plays, and

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: the engine keeps running. The strip's 'Stop engine'

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: only appears while the engine runs, so the two

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: square icons no longer share a meaning.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Quiet panes (UI-08)

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Candidates and tree stay empty with no placeholder

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: text, and the graph keeps its 0, 50 and 100 percent

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: axes, which UI-08 kept on purpose. The one change is

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: that the metrics row, which shows 'D: - N: -' dashes

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: today, is hidden until the engine reports.
